newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian ABO wants Euro.NM listing in autumn.
newsitem.headline: Belgian ABO wants Euro.NM listing in autumn.

text.p: Belgian Adviesbureau voor Bodemonderzoek (ABO), a firm specialising in soil and environmental consultancy, said in a statement on Thursday it planned to list on the Euro.NM exchange in the autumn of 1997.
Brokerage Nedee and Indosuez Bank Belgium, both part of the Cera-group, will lead the issue.

ABO, founded in 1995, said it wanted a listing to build up a European consultancy focused on environment, soil, real estate and construction. It employs 30 people and forecasts turnover of 60 to 100 million francs for 1997.
It would be the third listing on the fledgling Brussels arm of Euro.NM, a market for growth companies set up by the bourses of Paris, Brussels, Amsterdam and Frankfurt.
Number one and two are International Brachy Therapy and Synergia.
Belgian financial daily L'Echo said that Internoc, a Dutch information technology firm, also wants a listing on the Belgian Euro.NM. That operation would be led by brokerage Smeets Verbaet.
